summary: project.manager.test.ts passes code review. 45 tests across 10 well-structured sections cover the full ProjectManager API: list, create (ID inference, STABLE workspace auto-creation, validation, index sync), getById, update (field changes, DateModified, index sync), rename (file deletion/creation, index update, DateModified), remove (file deletion, index removal), addRepository/removeRepository (validation, DateModified), stateless multi-instance behaviour, STABLE workspace structure, and comprehensive CRUD round-trip. All error regex patterns verified against implementation strings. DateModified comparisons correctly use >= to handle same-millisecond scenarios. No blocking issues found.

comments.note: makeTestConfig() uses an implicit return type, same pattern as repository.manager.test.ts. Consistent across files, but if AppConfig gains a required field in the future, the compile error will surface at the call site rather than the helper definition. Low-risk given TypeScript's full-file checking, but explicit ': AppConfig' (as used in storage-init.test.ts) would be marginally safer.

DateModified comparisons use string >= comparison on ISO 8601 values. This is correct (ISO 8601 is lexicographically sortable), and using >= rather than > correctly handles the same-millisecond case in fast test runs. Pattern is intentional and sound — no change needed, documenting for future contributors.
